description: READ-LIFE and RO-FAIL on the ACE side: an owned reader dies inside a scan. Reader a opens the idx fixture shared read-only and runs SELECT SUM(LEN(M)), SUM(N) FROM T; b kills a 15 ms after the start signal (a had not signalled done), waits 0 / 100 / 500 / 1500 ms and each time opens shared read/write, updates row 1 (dbFailOnError, Errors before/after) and closes; it records the lock file's size and hash (P.Files) at each point and finally reads COUNT/SUM fresh. Asks how soon a killed reader's presence ends (lock-file entry, writer admission) and whether the file is intact.
retentionNote: Designed kill: participant b ends participant a with KillParticipant (TerminateProcess, exit 0xDEAD) at the probe's named delay, as b's capture records; a seals Uncertain by design and b's answers are the evidence.
